vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nm-scribe-doc-generator
Version: 1.0.1

The nm-scribe-doc-generator skill bundle is designed to help an AI agent generate and remediate documentation by following specific style guidelines and quality gates. It includes instructions for avoiding AI-generated clichés ('slop'), enforcing technical writing standards, and performing incremental edits on existing files. The skill uses standard file operations like 'cat' and 'grep' on documentation files and integrates with other internal skills (e.g., 'scribe:slop-detector') to verify content quality. No evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized execution was found across SKILL.md or the supporting modules.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only documentation helper that may read style files, edit documentation, and call related checking skills, but those behaviors are disclosed and fit the stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill’s purpose and behavior are coherent: it generates or remediates documentation. Because remediation can change local documentation or docstring text, users should scope target files and review diffs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow includes scope definition, preservation of meaning, quality checks, section-by-section approval for larger files, and final user approval.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install script or code is included. The skill references the broader Claude Code plugin and related scribe skills, which are outside this artifact review.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Local file reads such as a style profile and simple command examples are proportionate to documentation work; no credentials, environment variables, or hidden network endpoints are shown.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background process, persistence mechanism, credential use, privileged path access, or autonomous long-running behavior is present in the supplied artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears safe for documentation work. Before installing or invoking it, decide which files it may edit, review resulting diffs, and separately review any optional Claude Code plugin, slop-detector skill, or workspace style profile you choose to use.

evidence.explanation: The remediation workflow can edit existing documentation files. This is purpose-aligned and includes approval prompts, but it still means the skill may mutate workspace files when invoked.
evidence.snippet: For large files (>200 lines), edit incrementally: ... Proceed? [Y/n/edit]

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Specify target files, keep version-control diffs or backups, and review edits before accepting them.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may change documentation or docstring text in your project.

evidence.explanation: The skill itself is instruction-only, but it references an external plugin and related skill ecosystem that were not included in the reviewed artifacts.
evidence.snippet: For the full experience with agents, hooks, and commands, install the Claude Code plugin.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review any separately installed Claude Code plugin or scribe-related skills before enabling them.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Using the broader plugin or related skills may introduce behavior not visible in this review.

evidence.explanation: The skill may load a local style profile and apply its contents to generated documentation. This is expected for style guidance, but project-local guidance can influence the agent’s output.
evidence.snippet: cat .scribe/style-profile.yaml ... Apply voice, vocabulary, and structural guidelines.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use trusted style profiles and review them if they come from an unfamiliar repository.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A style profile in the workspace can steer how the agent writes or rewrites documentation.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill can edit documentation and references external related tooling, but this is disclosed and aligned with the documentation-generation purpose.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, account access, elevated privileges, or delegated authority are requested.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The skill may read a local style profile for context; no credential, session, or private-data exfiltration behavior is shown.
